title: Offsite planning call
text:
Ana: Thanks for joining. The main thing today is the team offsite.
Ben: Right. I think we should plan the offsite for March, before the busy season starts.
Ana: March works for me. Do we know how many people are coming?
Chloe: Fourteen from our team, and maybe two from design if they can get away.
Ben: Then we need a place with one big room and a couple of small ones for breakout sessions.
Ana: Last year the venue was too far from the station. Can we look for something we can reach by train?
Chloe: I have three options near the coast, all within an hour by train. I will send the list after this call.
Ben: What about the agenda? Last time we spent the whole first day on presentations.
Ana: Let's keep presentations to the first morning and spend the rest on planning the next half year.
Chloe: And one afternoon for something outdoors. People asked for that in the survey.
Ben: Budget is the open question. Finance said the travel budget is tight this quarter.
Ana: I will ask finance this week whether the offsite can come from the training budget instead.
Chloe: Then the next step is the venue list from me, the budget answer from Ana, and a draft agenda from Ben.
Ben: Agreed. Let's meet again next Thursday to decide on the venue.
